description: Synthetic nf_tables lab target for proving Madelin can capture and classify a controlled net use-after-free end to end.
success_criteria: KASAN or equivalent real kernel crash signal is observed
The crash reproduces at least twice under the same settings
The saved source frames show both nf_tables_destroy_set and nf_tables_dump_set
The runtime lane emits manual_known_bug_review.json and a minimized seed handoff artifact
does_not_prove: support outside the current lab-only proof target
